Senior Frontend Engineer

Position: Senior Frontend Engineer

Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)

Experience: 4–7 years

Job Overview

We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer with 4–7 years of experience to build intuitive, data-rich web applications. You'll combine strong technical skills with design sensibility to ship interfaces that make complex analytics easy to understand and act on. The right candidate is an independent thinker who can drive features from concept to delivery and uses modern tooling (including AI) to move fast without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain web applications using modern frontend frameworks, primarily React.js.
Create clean, visually engaging user interfaces with strong attention to spacing, alignment, contrast, and typography.
Develop responsive, cross-browser interfaces that work seamlessly across devices and screen sizes.
Interface with APIs, manage data-fetching and state, and handle errors gracefully - especially for data-heavy, visualization-centric views.

Identify and resolve frontend performance bottlenecks.

4–7 years of professional experience building and shipping web applications.
Strong command of web fundamentals: HTML5, CSS3 (Flexbox, Grid), ES6+ JavaScript, TypeScript, Tailwind, Zod.
Strong proficiency in React.js - Functional Components, Hooks, Context API, Router.
Experience with state management (e.g., Redux) and asynchronous operations / data-fetching (Fetch, error handling).
Demonstrated experience building responsive, cross-browser web interfaces.
A keen eye for design aesthetics, detail, and usability.
Strong command of Git/GitHub and version control workflows.
Familiarity with build tools and bundlers (Webpack, npm/yarn).
Comfort integrating AI tools into daily development to improve speed and quality.
An independent thinker, able to drive tasks forward with minimal oversight.
Strong problem-solving ability and logical reasoning.
Familiarity with REST API consumption at scale.
Experience building dashboards or data visualization interfaces (charts, tables, pivots).




Good to Have

UI automations/testing experience
Exposure to charting/visualization libraries (e.g., Recharts, D3, Chart.js).

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,000+ employees and 24,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.




AI at Cvent: Leading the Future:

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Full Stack Software Developer based in India.

This role offers the opportunity to build and evolve critical features across a modern SaaS platform serving a global user base. You’ll work across both frontend and backend systems, contributing to scalable, secure, and high-performance applications. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, designers, QA specialists, and fellow engineers in a fast-paced, distributed environment. The role combines hands-on software development with meaningful input into architecture, engineering practices, and technical decisions. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to automation and AI-enabled capabilities. This is a strong opportunity for an engineer who enjoys ownership, solving complex technical challenges, and helping shape products and engineering workflows as they scale.

Accountabilities


Design, develop, and maintain core platform features across frontend and backend systems. 
Contribute to technical decisions involving architecture, scalability, performance, security, reliability, and data integrity. 
Collaborate with product, design, QA, and engineering teams to deliver intuitive, reliable, and high-quality user experiences. 
Build clean, reusable, maintainable, secure, and testable code, including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. 
Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, standups, and other agile engineering activities. 
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues across the application stack. 
Help optimize application performance and contribute to automation, usability, developer experience, and engineering workflow improvements. 
Support the development of scalable systems and platform capabilities for a global user base. 


Requirements


3–5 years of professional experience in full stack software development, preferably within SaaS or enterprise environments. 
Strong experience with modern JavaScript technologies, particularly React and TypeScript, along with backend development using Node.js or Python. 
Solid understanding of RESTful services, API design, relational databases, and modern software development practices. 
Demonstrated ability to develop scalable, maintainable, secure, and well-tested software. 
Experience working in fast-paced startup environments and agile, collaborative engineering teams. 
Comfortable working remotely in a distributed, async-first environment and able to manage responsibilities independently. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a collaborative approach to working across engineering, product, design, and QA. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
Experience with technologies such as Next.js, Express, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD workflows is valuable. 
Nice-to-have experience includes HRIS, global payroll, workforce management, or other compliance-focused platforms; AWS; authentication and authorization frameworks such as OAuth and SSO; internationalization, role-based access control, or GDPR; and AI-enabled SaaS products. 


Benefits


Remote work opportunity with a distributed, async-first working environment. 
Opportunity to work on a global SaaS platform with meaningful technical ownership and impact.

What you will own

Product engineering

Translate product ideas and business requirements into clear technical plans, milestones and production-ready features.
Own features end to end: discovery, technical design, implementation, testing, release, monitoring and iteration.
Balance speed with maintainability, security, scalability and a high-quality user experience.
Contribute product judgment—not only code—by identifying edge cases, simplifying flows and recommending better solutions. 




FULL STACK DEVELOPER




Mobile and web experiences

Build and maintain the consumer mobile application in Flutter, including camera access, video capture and upload, challenge participation, profiles, rewards, notifications and leaderboards.
Develop responsive web applications and dashboards using React/Next.js for enterprise users, administrators, creators and brand partners.
Turn designs into polished, intuitive interfaces with strong attention to layout, motion, responsiveness, accessibility and consistency.
Improve application performance across device types, browsers, network conditions and large media files.




Backend, data and platform architecture

Engineering quality and operations

Set up and improve automated testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, error tracking, logging and production alerts.

Who We Are

Yieldmo is an advertising platform that helps brands invent creative experiences through tech and AI, using custom ad formats, proprietary attention signals, predictive format selection, and privacy-safe premium inventory curation. We believe all ads should be human-centered, tailored, and provoke emotion and action. Yieldmo helps brands deliver the best ad for every impression opportunity, merging creative and media for proven results.

The Role

We're hiring a Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer (5–10 years of experience) to help build Yieldmo's AI-powered search engine, which will change how users discover and engage with content across major publishers. This is a full-stack role with a strong ML component. You'll build backend services and ML-powered features, and ship the user-facing interfaces that bring them to life. We care most about builders: engineers who write production code, iterate quickly, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and own their work end to end.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and operate backend services and APIs that power AI-driven search, including retrieval, ranking, and indexing components.
Build and deploy ML features into production: embeddings, vector search, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, and model evaluation.
Develop responsive, performant front-end experiences that surface search results and AI features to users and internal teams.
Build and maintain data and content ingestion pipelines that feed the search system.
Own features end to end, from prototype through production, monitoring, and iteration.
Partner with Product, ML, and Engineering teams to turn requirements into shipped features.
Drive quality, performance, and reliability for the services you own, including testing, code reviews, and observability.
Share knowledge and support teammates; senior engineers will mentor others and contribute to technical design decisions.


Requirements


Must be based in India.
5–10 years of professional software engineering experience, building and operating production systems.
Strong backend skills in Python, with solid SQL and experience designing APIs and microservices.
Hands-on front-end experience with a modern framework (React preferred) plus JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
Practical ML experience in production: working with embeddings, vector databases, LLMs, RAG, or ranking/recommendation models.
Experience with Docker, cloud platforms (AWS or GCP), and CI/CD.
Strong fundamentals in data structures, system design, and testing.
Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working cross-functionally in a fast-moving, remote team.
An ownership mindset: you ship, measure, and improve.


Nice to Haves

job.title: FULLSTACK DEVELOPER - ENTERPRISE AI PLATFORMS (GEMINI)
job.description:
FULLSTACK DEVELOPER ENTERPRISE AI PLATFORMS (GEMINI)

Location: Remote | Type: Full-time / Contract

About Newpage Solutions

Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations including pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders to build transformative AI and data-driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.

From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centred practices.

We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified for three consecutive years, hold a top Glassdoor rating, and were named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. We foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people's lives.

Your Mission

We are hiring a Fullstack Developer who knows the Gemini platform from the inside how Gemini Enterprise is administered, how agents, data connectors, extensions and Gems are built, registered, scoped and distributed, and how access and permissions actually flow through them.

You will be embedded with a large enterprise client as part of a small engineering pod, alongside engineers who own other enterprise AI platforms. You will own the path by which new data connectors, agents and skills reach users: from intake through access group creation, identity provider synchronisation, connector registration, per-tool permission scoping, testing, documentation and closure with the requester. You will review third-party components for security and quality before release, and replace manual console work with automated, repeatable pipelines.

This is not an administration role. Most of your time goes into building: the backend services, data mappings and integrations that wire the platform into the client's systems, and the internal tooling that gives platform owners visibility and control over how AI capabilities are being used. You should be as strong in the backend APIs, identity, data, infrastructure as code as you are in the UI.

You won't wait for a refined backlog or a separate platform team. You will take a vague request, work out what is actually needed, build it, and stand it up in production yourself. This is a builder role for engineers who combine solid fullstack fundamentals with a deep, practical understanding of the Gemini platform and its extension model.

What You'll Do

Build & Integrate


Design and build the backend services, APIs and data mappings that connect Gemini to enterprise systems identity, data sources, ticketing and the connectors in between.
Build internal tooling and admin interfaces (React / Next.js over Python or TypeScript backends) that give platform owners visibility into usage and control over which capabilities are available to whom.
Build or integrate agents and extensions for the client's own use cases Agent Designer, ADK, Gemini CLI extensions, or LLM-powered services and agents on whichever orchestration framework fits (LangGraph, Google ADK, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK or similar), integrating models through APIs, tool calling / MCP and structured outputs and register them in Gemini Enterprise so the right people can use them.
Take a vague request from a business or platform owner, work out what is actually needed, ship a working version quickly, and harden what survives contact with real users.


Own Connector & Agent Requests End to End


Own data connector, agent and skill requests for the enterprise Gemini platform from intake through to closure with the requester.
Create access groups and manage identity provider synchronisation (SSO / SCIM with Okta, Entra ID or Google Cloud Identity) so access follows existing team and group structures.
Register connectors and data stores and apply per-tool permission scoping, granting only the access each capability needs.
Test each connector and agent before release, document what it does and how to use it, and close the loop with the requester.


Configure, Distribute & Review Platform Capabilities


Configure and distribute agents, skills, extensions and Gems to the right audience enterprise-wide, group-scoped or on request with a clear understanding of the scoping controls and what each one actually gates.
Conduct security and quality reviews of third-party and externally authored agents, extensions and connectors before release: dependencies, bundled scripts, and exposure to prompt injection or data exfiltration.
Define remediation or approval decisions and document them so the standard is repeatable.


Automate Provisioning


Automate setup, registration and provisioning through CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (Terraform) in place of manual console configuration.
Build parameterised deployments across development, staging and production environments.
Turn recurring manual requests into reusable, version-controlled automation.


What You Bring


5+ years building production fullstack applications in Python and TypeScript APIs, integrations and modern web frameworks (FastAPI, Node / Fastify, React / Next.js). You are backend-strong: data mappings, integration plumbing and wiring systems together is where you spend most of your time, not just the UI.
Deep, hands-on knowledge of the Gemini platform: Gemini Enterprise administration (data connectors and data stores, agent registration, end-user feature controls, IdP-synced groups and access) and the Gemini API, plus Gemini for Google Workspace (Gems and admin controls) where it is in use. You know how capabilities are packaged, scoped and distributed and where the sharp edges are. Familiarity with Vertex AI and the agent stack (ADK, Agent Runtime, Agent Registry, A2A) is useful rather than essential.
Hands-on experience with Gemini function calling / tool use and MCP servers, including tool permissions and capability scoping.
Hands-on experience building agents or LLM integrations with at least one orchestration framework (LangGraph, Google ADK, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK or similar), and comfortable switching the team's framework is not fixed.
Security-minded reviewing of code and AI components: dependency analysis, script review, and a practical understanding of prompt injection and data exfiltration risks.
CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Cloud Build or similar) and infrastructure as code with Terraform across AWS, Google Cloud or Azure, including parameterised multi-environment deployments.
Structured, disciplined use of AI-assisted development (Gemini CLI, Claude Code or similar) with review, not on autopilot.
Clear written communication, and the confidence to reframe a vague request into something concrete rather than wait for someone else to define it.
Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or a related technical discipline.


Bonus Skills / Experience


Working knowledge of a second enterprise AI platform Claude (Claude Enterprise, Claude Code), Microsoft Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock or Azure AI Foundry. A strong plus: you will be expected to provide cover across platforms.
Background in AppSec, supply-chain security or security review processes.
Experience in pharma, life sciences or other regulated industries.
Relevant cloud or security certifications (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Terraform Associate).
A recent public trail of built things GitHub, side projects, OSS contributions, or writing about building with AI.


What We Offer

At Newpage, we're building a company that works smart and grows with agility where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer:


A people-first culture supportive peers, open communication, and a strong sense of belonging.
Smart, purposeful collaboration work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges.
Balance that lasts we respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life.
Room to grow opportunities for learning, leadership, and career development, shaped around you.
Meaningful rewards competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential.


Ready to Apply?

Let's build the future of health together. Apply below or reach out to shubhi.tiwari@newpage.io with any questions.

Shipped and owns at least one production service independently

Your Benefits 

Best in the Industry compensation

High technical ownership 
Long-term architectural responsibility 
Modern tech environment 
Direct, visible impact — your work shapes the product from day one, not buried in a massive codebase 




Your application 

If you want to build products end-to-end and help shape an engineering team from its earliest days, we'd love to hear from you.

newboxes is an engineering-focused management and innovation consultancy. Our team spans Germany and India, and Chennai is where we're building that engineering capability from the ground up. job.title: System Architecture Designer
job.description:
About College Circle AI

At College Circle AI, we believe that curiosity should never die in a classroom. We are

building an AI-powered learning ecosystem that helps students understand concepts

better, identify their weak areas, and receive personalized academic support beyond

traditional classrooms.




Built for Students, by Students. We are a team of students, builders, and innovators

who have experienced the challenges of modern education firsthand. Every product,

feature, and initiative is designed with one goal: helping students learn better, grow

faster, and unlock their full potential.




Our mission is to empower millions of learners with smarter learning, stronger career

readiness, and equal access to guidance whenever they need it. If you are passionate

about education, technology, and creating real impact, you'll feel right at home here.

Building the Future of Academic Intelligence




We are looking for a System Architecture Designer who can step back, understand the entire system, identify where the architecture is breaking, and design the architecture required for the next 10,000+ users and systems.




This is not simply a debugging role. You will work on how the entire technology system should be structured, connected, monitored, and scaled.




What You Will Work On
Study the current CCAI technology architecture and identify structural problems.
Map the complete system: frontend, backend, APIs, databases, AI services, authentication, integrations, deployment and data flow.
Identify recurring bugs and determine whether they are caused by implementation, dependencies, architecture or system design.
Redesign weak or fragile parts of the architecture.
Create a scalable architecture capable of supporting the next stage of users and product complexity.
Design clear communication between different services, APIs and modules.
Improve reliability, performance, security and maintainability.
Establish systems for error handling, logging, monitoring and debugging.
Identify technical debt and create a structured plan to resolve it.
Work closely with Backend, Full-Stack, AI/Research and Product teams.
Create architecture documentation that developers can actually follow.
Review major technical decisions before implementation.
Think about how today's technical decisions will affect the platform at 10,000 → 100,000 → 1M+ users.

The Core Problem You Will Solve

We don't want:

“There is a bug, let's fix the bug.”

We want:

“Why did this class of bug become possible in the first place, and how should we design the system so that it does not repeatedly happen?”

You will be responsible for finding those patterns.




What We Are Looking For

You may come from backgrounds such as:

System Architecture
Software Architecture
Backend Engineering
Full-Stack Engineering
DevOps / Infrastructure
Distributed Systems
Platform Engineering
Technical Product Engineering

You do not need to have the exact title “System Architect” on your resume.

What matters is that you can understand a complex technical system, identify structural problems, and design a better one.




Strong Candidates Will Have




Strong understanding of backend and system architecture
Experience designing APIs and service communication
Understanding of databases and data modelling
Experience with scalable applications
Knowledge of deployment, CI/CD and infrastructure
Understanding of authentication, authorization and security
Experience with logging, monitoring and observability
Ability to debug problems across multiple systems
Ability to identify technical debt and architectural weaknesses
Strong documentation and system-design skills
Ability to think beyond the current implementation
Ownership mindset and willingness to work closely with developers


Current Technology Environment




Our current environment includes technologies such as:

Frontend: React / Next.js / JavaScript / TypeScript / Tailwind

 Backend: Node.js / Express

 Database: PostgreSQL / Supabase

 Infrastructure: Cloud deployment, CI/CD and GitHub-based workflows

 AI: AI models, APIs and research-driven AI systems

You don't need to know every technology beforehand, but you should be comfortable understanding and designing systems around them.




Your First Mission




Your first assignment will be to:

Audit the existing architecture → identify critical architectural problems → trace recurring bugs → propose a redesigned architecture → create a roadmap for implementation.

We want to understand how you think before asking you to redesign anything.




Why This Role Is Different




You will not only be given tickets to complete.

You will have the opportunity to influence:

How College Circle AI is technically built.

Your decisions can affect our:

Product architecture
Engineering workflows
Data architecture
AI infrastructure
Scalability
Reliability
Security
Future technical team

This is a builder role for someone who enjoys solving system-level problems.




What You Can Grow Into




Depending on contribution and ownership, this role can evolve toward:

System Architect → Platform Architect → Chief Technology Architecture / Technology Leadership

For long-term Co-Builders, equity opportunities may also be considered based on contribution, ownership, performance, tenure and formal company agreements. Equity is not automatic.




Who Should Apply?

Apply if you look at a technical problem and naturally ask:

“Why is the system designed this way?”

rather than only:

“How do I fix this error?”

If you want to help design the technical foundation on which the next 10,000+ users and future systems of College Circle AI can operate, this role is for you.

The core ask is straightforward: the right front-end stack, and the ability to take a software requirement and own it end-to-end through the SDLC. Domain exposure (Industrial Systems & Decision Intelligence) is a bonus, not a prerequisite — we look for strong engineering fundamentals and grow the domain knowledge on the job.

Understand software requirements and take full ownership through the SDLC — design, build, test, deploy, monitor and maintain

Solid TypeScript fundamentals — not just framework familiarity 
Experience integrating with REST or GraphQL APIs 
Demonstrated ability to take a requirement from spec to shipped feature with minimal hand-holding 
Comfort working in a small team with high autonomy, in hybrid mode

Basic exposure to AI/ML, Enterprise AI, Agentic AI is a plus. 

 

What success looks like in the first 90 days 

Shipped at least one meaningful feature into production independently, start to finish

Comfortable with the team's async collaboration rhythm with German Time zone (CET/ CEST) 

 

Working Model 

Work from our office in Chennai and/or in Hybrid mode. 
Close daily collaboration with our team in Germany, with at least 4 to 5 hours of overlap 
You will work closely with product, engineering, and domain experts rather than in isolation 
We build products for the long term and value getting things right over shipping fast 

 

Your Benefits 

Best in the Industry Compensation 
30 days paid vacation per year 
High technical ownership & long-term architectural responsibility 
Modern tech environment 
Direct, visible impact — your work shapes the product from day one, not buried in a massive codebase 




Your application 

If you want to build products end-to-end and help shape an engineering team from its earliest days, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

About us 

newboxes is an engineering-focused management and innovation consultancy. We help industrial and manufacturing organizations solve hard problems in risk, safety, cost, and complexity — combining systems thinking with real, hands-on software engineering. Our team spans Germany and India, and Chennai is where we're building that engineering capability from the ground up. job.title: Lead Principal Software Engineer
job.description:
Principal Lead Software Engineer (AI-Native)

Location: Hyderabad, India

Employment: Full-time · Early-stage, founder-led company

Compensation: As per Market Standards for this role




About Us

We are an early-stage company building applied AI products for complex professional workflows, including healthcare and legal.

Our focus is practical: software that professionals can trust and use in their daily work. That requires more than an impressive AI demo—it requires reliable engineering, thoughtful user experiences, strong data foundations, and disciplined validation.

We operate with a small team, direct founder involvement, and AI-assisted development as standard practice. Specific product details will be shared during the interview process.




The Role

We are looking for a hands-on engineering leader who can own multiple AI products end-to-end—not just an AI component, backend service, or prototype.

You will take products from requirements and architecture through implementation, integration, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. The work spans AI-powered applications, voice and document workflows, knowledge systems, and the shared infrastructure supporting them.

You will work directly with the founder, who leads product direction, priorities, and customer requirements. You will own engineering execution and technical decisions, enabling the founder to focus on product rather than daily code reviews, debugging, and integration management.

This is a player-coach role: you will write production code, lead a small engineering team, and remain accountable for whether the complete product actually works.




What You Will Own

End-to-end product delivery. Turn product requirements into working applications across the frontend, backend, AI layer, data systems, and infrastructure. Own the complete user journey—not merely whether individual components run.
Architecture and technical decisions. Choose appropriate technologies, define clear interfaces, and make practical build-versus-buy decisions. Build reusable capabilities across products without creating unnecessary abstraction or complexity.
Applied AI engineering. Build and integrate LLM-powered features, retrieval and knowledge workflows, structured outputs, and speech or voice capabilities. Know when to use a model, conventional software, deterministic validation, or human review.
Independent verification and release quality. Establish automated tests, AI evaluation suites, regression checks, and end-to-end acceptance tests. Reproduce failures, investigate root causes, and demonstrate fixes with evidence. Establish effective code review and quality gates without relying on the founder as the default reviewer.
Reliable data and production systems. Turn imperfect source data into validated, traceable, versioned datasets and services. Own deployment, observability, error handling, recovery, latency, and operating costs.
Security and responsible implementation. Build appropriate access controls, sensitive-data handling, audit trails, and safeguards. Work with domain experts to translate professional requirements into testable engineering behavior.
Team leadership and execution. Break work into achievable milestones, delegate clearly, review critical changes, mentor engineers, and resolve integration blockers. Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs early—with working demonstrations and honest quality results.




What We Are Looking For

10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 4+ years owning architecture and technical decisions for production systems and 2+ years leading or mentoring engineers.
Demonstrated full-stack ownership. You have personally delivered complete products across APIs, databases, user interfaces, integrations, and cloud infrastructure—not only contributed to a narrow layer.
Production AI experience. You have shipped at least two AI/LLM-powered products or substantial features into real use. You can explain the reliability, evaluation, latency, cost, and operational trade-offs you encountered.
Strong implementation skills. Expert-level Python, strong React/TypeScript, solid SQL and data-modeling skills, and hands-on experience with cloud deployment, CI/CD, and security fundamentals.
Evidence of self-verification. You can show or explain a test or evaluation system you built, the failures it caught, and how you determined that a release was ready.
Practical AI-native development experience. You actively use tools such as Claude Code or equivalent to accelerate delivery, while independently reviewing, testing, and taking responsibility for the resulting code.
Independent engineering judgment. You can work through incomplete requirements, inspect actual data before making assumptions, diagnose unfamiliar failures, and make sensible decisions without constant technical supervision.




Experience That Helps

Healthcare or legal experience is valuable, but not mandatory. Relevant experience includes:

Healthcare software, clinical workflows, EHR/EMR integrations, or applications handling sensitive health information.
Legal technology, law-firm workflows, document-heavy professional systems, or confidential client information.
Speech and voice products, including streaming transcription, speaker separation, multilingual audio, or code-switching.
Founding-engineer roles, small-team product ownership, or products built for the Indian market.




Our Technical Environment

Backend and data: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, vector search, Redis.

AI: LLM APIs, retrieval/RAG, structured outputs, evaluation frameworks, and speech integrations.

Frontend: React and TypeScript.

Infrastructure: Cloud services, Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, and automated quality gates.

Development: AI-assisted coding, supported by engineering review and testing.

You do not need prior experience with every tool. You do need the depth to own the system and learn unfamiliar parts without making the founder the integration layer.




What Success Looks Like

Products work end-to-end in realistic user workflows—not just in isolated demos. Releases are supported by reproducible tests and meaningful quality evidence. Failures are identified and addressed before customers or the founder become the primary testers.

The team delivers against clear milestones, raises risks early, and improves its ability to work independently. The founder can focus on what to build and why, while trusting you to lead how it is built, verified, and operated.




What We Offer

Principal-level scope across multiple products, direct partnership with the founder, and the opportunity to shape architecture, engineering standards, and a growing team.

You will have substantial technical ownership and a hands-on role in turning early products into dependable production systems.




How to Apply

Send your résumé or LinkedIn profile to dinesh@astroum.ai, along with brief answers to these three questions:

What is a production system you personally owned end-to-end? Explain what you built, the decisions you made, and one decision you would change today.
How do you verify your work without depending on someone else to catch your mistakes? Describe a test or evaluation harness you built, a serious failure it caught, and how you verified the fix.
What have you recently shipped using AI-assisted development? Explain how you used the tools, where their output was wrong or incomplete, and how you made the final result production-ready.
Public code, demos, or architecture examples are welcome but not required. Anonymized examples are fine; please do not share confidential employer or client material.

Build. Launch. Scale. Share the Upside.

We’re not really looking for an employee.




We’re looking for another entrepreneur who happens to be an exceptional developer.




Our team constantly researches markets, studies emerging products, discovers underserved opportunities and identifies ideas that we believe can become serious businesses.

When we find one, we don’t spend six months making PowerPoints.

We build it.

And that’s where you come in.

What You’ll Do

You’ll take products from “this could be interesting” to a working product in the hands of real users.

You should be comfortable starting with a blank repo and figuring out everything required to ship.

You’ll:

Build high-quality applications for iOS and Android
Choose the right technology stack for each product
Architect the frontend, backend, APIs and database
Integrate AI models, APIs, payments, authentication, analytics and third-party services
Turn Figma designs and rough product ideas into polished experiences
Build MVPs quickly without building disposable software
Set up cloud infrastructure, deployment and monitoring
Publish and manage applications on the App Store and Google Play
Study user behaviour after launch
Fix what users hate
Double down on what users love
Help scale products from the first 100 users to potentially hundreds of thousands

Sometimes you'll receive a detailed PRD.

Sometimes you'll receive a sentence:

“I think there’s a business here.”

You should enjoy figuring out everything that happens after that sentence.

The Kind of Developer We Want

You’re probably someone who has built things outside your job.

Maybe you’ve launched an app.

Maybe you’ve tried a startup.

Maybe you have 25 unfinished side projects sitting on GitHub.

Maybe you spend your weekends experimenting with AI tools because you’re curious about what they can do.

That’s our kind of person.

You should be comfortable with technologies such as:

Mobile

Swift / SwiftUI
Kotlin / Jetpack Compose
Flutter or React Native

Backend

Node.js / Python / similar modern frameworks
REST / GraphQL APIs
PostgreSQL / Firebase / Supabase / similar databases

Infrastructure

Serverless architecture
CI/CD
Docker
Monitoring and analytics

AI

OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini APIs
AI agents and automation
Computer vision or multimodal AI where relevant
Rapid experimentation using modern AI coding tools

You don't need to know every technology above.

You do need to be the kind of engineer who can learn whatever is required to get the product shipped.

Our PhilosophyEveryone Here Is an Entrepreneur.

We research ideas.

We invest in ideas.

We build them.

We launch them.

We market them.

We scale the ones that work.

And when we create meaningful value, we want the people who helped create that value to participate in the upside.

Alongside compensation, selected products may include revenue-sharing, incentives or other upside structures based on the product, contribution and commercial model.

We want developers thinking:

“How do we get 100,000 people to use this?”

Not just:

“My ticket is complete.”You’ll Love This Role If...
You hate bureaucracy.

About Parafox Technologies

Parafox Technologies is a cutting-edge cyber security and IT GRC Consulting company headquartered in India. We specialize in helping businesses safeguard their critical data, protect against evolving cyber threats, meet regulatory and compliance requirements, and strengthen their digital infrastructure. At Parafox Technologies, we believe in innovation, agility, and a security-first mindset. Our solutions are designed to help organizations build stronger security foundations, simplify compliance, and stay prepared in an increasingly connected digital world.




About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and driven Senior Full Stack Developer to join Parafox Technologies. In this role, you will own the design, development, and delivery of modern, scalable, and security-focused products across the full stack, from intuitive front-end experiences to robust back-end services and cloud infrastructure.




The Senior Full Stack Developer will lead development across the entire software development lifecycle, including architecture, coding, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, cloud deployment, and monitoring. You will work closely with product, security, and leadership teams, and mentor junior developers and interns while setting high standards for code quality and engineering practices.




Key Responsibilities

The Senior Full Stack Developer will be responsible for the following:

Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end web applications using Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) on the back end and AngularJS with Tailwind CSS on the front end.
Architect scalable systems including microservices, REST APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure, and make sound technical decisions on design and trade-offs.
Build secure, high-performance REST APIs and real-time data pipelines with strong authentication, authorization, and input validation.
Develop responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect user interfaces using AngularJS and Tailwind CSS, translating designs into reusable components.
Own DevOps practices: set up, manage, and optimize CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar) for automated build, test, and deployment.
Containerize applications using Docker and manage container orchestration with Kubernetes or equivalent tools.
Manage multi-cloud deployments across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including Cloudflare configuration, and apply Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar).
Implement load balancing, auto-scaling, and service orchestration to ensure high availability, resilience, and performance.
Design, optimize, and maintain PostgreSQL databases with secure, auditable data handling, efficient queries, and reliable backup strategies.
Lead development of the GRC platform aligned with standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS, including automated compliance and risk assessment features.
Drive development of the security awareness platform, including phishing simulation features, and build AI-powered cybersecurity features.
Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch, or similar) and proactively resolve production issues.
Follow and enforce secure coding practices (OWASP Top 10) and support security reviews, vulnerability remediation, and audits.
Conduct code reviews, define coding standards, and mentor junior developers and interns.
Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; maintain clear technical documentation; and collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment.




Required Skills and Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, or a related field.
Minimum 4 - 5 years of professional experience in full stack development, with a proven track record of shipping production applications.
Strong proficiency in Python and at least one framework such as Flask, Django, or FastAPI.
Hands-on experience with AngularJS (experience with Angular 2+ is a plus), along with JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Solid experience building modern UIs with Tailwind CSS.
Practical DevOps experience, including CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and Linux server administration.
Experience deploying and managing applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL (or other relational databases), data modelling, and query optimization.
In-depth understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and system design principles.
Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows such as branching strategies and pull request reviews.
Good understanding of application security concepts such as authentication, encryption, and OWASP guidelines.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills with excellent attention to detail.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work independently and lead within a team.

Experience in the cybersecurity, GRC, or compliance domain.
Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS.
Exposure to AI/ML integration, LLM APIs, or building AI-powered product features.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
Knowledge of message queues and caching tools such as Redis, RabbitMQ, or Kafka.
Relevant certifications such as AWS/Azure/GCP Certified, CKA, or Security+.

job.title: Junior Web Developer
job.description:
Junior Web Developer — Web, Digital & Creative TechnologyYou don't need 10 years of experience.You need curiosity, good fundamentals, and the hunger to build.

Some developers wait years before they're trusted with something that actually goes live.

We don't want you to.

What A Story is an international wedding photography & filmmaking brand creating stories across India and the United States.

Behind all those photographs, films and weddings is something equally important:

Technology.

Our websites.

Landing pages.

Client experiences.

Internal tools.

Automations.

Digital campaigns.

And a growing list of ideas we're waiting to build.

We're looking for a Junior Web Developer who wants to grow by actually building things people use.

Your Playground

One week, you might be improving the experience of our website.

The next, building a beautiful landing page for a new campaign.

Then fixing something that mysteriously broke at 2 AM even though “nobody changed anything.”

Welcome to development. :)

You'll work across projects involving:

WordPress & Web Development

Landing Pages

Frontend Development

Website Performance

Forms & Integrations

APIs

CRM Integrations

Analytics & Tracking

SEO Implementation

Automations

Internal Tools

And new digital experiences we haven't built yet.

We Care About How You Think.

We don't expect a junior developer to know everything.

Actually, we'd be suspicious if you claimed you did.

What matters is what happens when you don't know something.

Do you Google it?

Read documentation?

Experiment?

Break it?

Understand why it broke?

Fix it?

And remember what you learned?

That's the developer we want.

We'd Love You to Know Some of This

HTML.

CSS.

JavaScript.

WordPress.

Basic PHP.

Responsive web development.

Git / version control.

APIs and integrations.

Basic understanding of hosting, domains and website performance.

If you've played with modern frameworks, databases, automation tools, AI APIs or cloud platforms — even better.

But don't avoid applying because you don't tick every box.

Show us what you can build.

That matters more.

Design Matters Here.

We're a visual company.

So “technically working” isn't always enough.

A button can work and still look terrible.

A page can load and still feel boring.

A website can be technically perfect and still make someone want to leave.

We want a developer who notices those things.

You don't have to be a designer.

But you should care about:

Spacing.

Typography.

Responsiveness.

Animation.

Speed.

Details.

And how something feels to use.

Because good development and good design should never feel like strangers.

AI Is Welcome Here.

Use it.

ChatGPT.

Claude.

GitHub Copilot.

Whatever makes you better and faster.

We don't care whether you typed every single line yourself.

We care whether you understand what you're shipping.

If AI gives you code and you blindly paste it into production...

That's a problem.

If AI helps you build something in two hours that would normally take you two days — and you understand exactly how it works...

That's smart development.

You'll Probably Fit In If…

You're the person who opens Inspect Element just because you're curious how a website did something.

You've built side projects nobody asked you to build.

You sometimes spend hours solving a bug and feel ridiculously happy when the solution turns out to be one line.

You learn things because you want to know how they work.

You'd rather show us something you've built than spend 20 minutes explaining how passionate you are about coding.

And you're looking for a place where you can grow fast.

What You'll Get Here

Real projects.

Real users.

Real responsibility.

And yes...

real bugs.

You'll see your work go live.

You'll learn from mistakes.

You'll experiment.

You'll work alongside creative, marketing and business teams.

And as the brand grows internationally, the technology behind it needs to grow too.

We want you to grow with it.

When You Apply…

Your degree is interesting.

Your resume is useful.

But you know what we'd really like to see?

Something you built.

A website.

A GitHub project.

A weird experiment.

A college project you're secretly proud of.

A tool you made because you were too lazy to do something manually.

Even something unfinished.

Show us how you think.

We're not searching for the developer who already knows everything.

We're searching for the one who can't stop learning.

Accelerate Performance.




About CAI Software

CAI Software builds purpose-built solutions that help manufacturers, processors, and distributors accelerate performance. CAI Business Units and the Markets We Serve




CAI Software is organized into three business units: Graphic Communications, Process Manufacturing, and Discrete Manufacturing - aligned to the industries we serve. This structure keeps our teams close to customer needs while operating with the scale and support of a global software company.




This role is part of our Discrete Manufacturing business unit, which delivers software solutions for manufacturers that produce components and assemblies that become part of larger products. Serving small through enterprise manufacturers in industries such as aerospace, automotive, industrial equipment, and engineered products, Discrete Manufacturing focuses on modern execution—connecting planning, production, traceability, and automation to help manufacturers run more resilient, efficient, and predictable operations. 







CAI India 

CAI India is a strategic investment in the company’s future. Our Bangalore Center of Excellence is a place of ownership, expertise, and accountability. Teams in India work on global products end to end, contribute to key decisions, and influence how CAI evolves as a business. This is not a support-led model, but rather a center designed to lead through knowledge, responsibility, and trust.




About the Role




CAI Software’s Discrete Manufacturing Business Unit is hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer for our EDI Products team, backfilling a departing team member. This is a dual-scope role: part software architect, part hands-on full stack engineer. The person in this seat will help define the target architecture for modernizing our legacy EDI platform (iCARaS, iR*EDI, and iSC) and will personally build significant parts of that modernization — from middleware and data access through to the Angular front end. We’re looking for someone who can operate comfortably at both ends: making sound architectural calls and writing production-quality code, while using AI-assisted development to move faster without sacrificing quality.




Key Responsibilities




Act as a technical architect for the legacy-to-modern transformation of the EDI Products platform — proposing target-state architecture, evaluating trade-offs, and documenting decisions.
Design and build full stack features end-to-end: Angular/TypeScript front end, .NET-based middleware (HarmonyCore), and the underlying data layer (ISAM/SQL-style access).
Lead the technical approach for migrating functionality off the legacy Synergy DBL/ISAM and ExtJS stack toward a modern .NET and Angular architecture.
Use AI-assisted development tools as a core part of the daily workflow — for implementation, refactoring, test generation, and code review — and help raise the bar for AI-led development practices across the team.
Apply working knowledge of EDI concepts (trading-partner transactions, ASNs, mapping/translation, X12 standards) to ensure modernization work preserves business-critical behavior.
Break down architecture and epics into well-scoped stories in Azure DevOps (ADO), and manage code through ADO-Git (branching, pull requests, code review).
Collaborate with the Engineering Manager and Product Managers/Product Owners in Aha! to align technical planning with roadmap priorities.
Keep architecture decisions, designs, and technical documentation current in Confluence for the team and cross-functional stakeholders.
Mentor other engineers on full stack development practices, code quality, and modernization patterns.
Identify technical risk and legacy-system pitfalls early, and propose pragmatic mitigation paths.




AI-Led Development




This role is expected to model AI-led development for the team:

Use AI coding assistants fluently for implementation, debugging, refactoring, and test coverage across the stack.
Apply sound judgment about when and how to use AI-generated code responsibly, especially around legacy business logic.
Contribute to team norms/guardrails for secure, effective AI tool usage.




Tools & Platforms




Azure DevOps (ADO) and ADO-Git
Aha! (roadmap and planning alignment)
Confluence (architecture and engineering documentation)
AI-assisted development tooling as adopted by the organization




Required Qualifications




Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field from a Tier-1 or Tier-2 institution (e.g., IITs, NITs, IIITs, or equivalent top-ranked engineering colleges) strongly preferred.
5+ years of professional full stack development experience, with demonstrated ability to work across front end, middleware, and data layers.
Strong front-end skills in Angular (or equivalent modern framework) and TypeScript/JavaScript.
Strong back-end skills in .NET / C#, with experience designing and building APIs and middleware services.
Solid understanding of relational and/or legacy data access patterns (SQL; exposure to ISAM or similar older data stores is a plus).
Experience or working knowledge of EDI (electronic data interchange) concepts — X12 standards, trading-partner transactions, ASNs, or mapping/translation tools.
Demonstrated experience acting in an architect-level capacity: system design, technology trade-off analysis, and technical documentation.
Hands-on, daily experience using AI-assisted development tools in a professional setting.
Experience working in Azure DevOps (ADO/ADO-Git) for planning and source control.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.




Preferred Qualifications




Experience modernizing or re-platforming a legacy monolith into a service-oriented or cloud-friendly architecture.
Familiarity with Synergy DBL, ExtJS, or other legacy enterprise stacks.
Experience with Aha! for roadmap planning and Confluence for architecture documentation.
Background in automotive, manufacturing, or B2B integration software domains.




What Success Looks Like




A clear, well-documented target architecture for modernizing the EDI Products platform, with team buy-in.
Tangible modernization progress shipped incrementally, without disrupting existing customer-facing functionality.
Visible, effective use of AI-led development that measurably improves delivery speed and code quality.
Strong technical documentation in Confluence and clean, well-managed work in ADO/ADO-Git.







CAI Software’s Discrete Manufacturing Business Unit delivers EDI and B2B integration products — including iCARaS, iREDI, and iSC — that help automotive and discrete manufacturers manage trading-partner communications, demand signals, shipping and labeling compliance, and supplier collaboration. The team is investing in modernizing its technology stack and adopting AI-led development to accelerate delivery while maintaining the reliability our customers depend on.







Why Join CAI

At CAI, we are building something that matters. With 6,200+ customers across 15+ industries and active investment in AI-driven performance tools, we are positioned to define what the next generation of manufacturing software looks like — and we are building the team to lead that work.

Our four pillars define how we deliver for customers — and how we work:

Built to Expedite - Speeds time to performance without heavy lifts or delays.

WHY JOIN US

As the global leader in AI-powered recruitment marketing, we are transforming talent attraction and recruitment media buying for the world’s largest and smartest employers, staffing businesses, RPOs, and recruitment advertising agencies.

The Vision

Joveo is on a mission to fundamentally rewrite the rules of the recruitment industry through AI. The New Initiatives AI Labs is our "Special Ops" team—a high-speed, high-stakes environment where we build the future of the company from the ground up.
